distribution_profiles.description: IDE only: editor, Git, terminal, tasks, reviewable patches, and adapter settings. No model weights included.
Core plus Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B Instruct Q4_K_M, downloaded or imported after license and hardware checks.
Core plus model registry, cross-model coordinator, benchmark runner, training timeline, eval cards, and release tools.
distribution_profiles.recommended_for: showing how the owner's models are trained, evaluated, and promoted

recommended_coding_models.name: Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B Instruct
recommended_coding_models.reason: Best first small coding pack for constrained hardware; use a compatible quantized format and verify its upstream license before redistribution.

recommended_coding_models.name: DeepSeek-Coder 1.3B Instruct
recommended_coding_models.reason: Small alternative for code completion and simple patch generation; benchmark against Qwen rather than assuming it is stronger.

recommended_coding_models.name: Qwen2.5-Coder 3B Instruct
recommended_coding_models.reason: Higher-quality optional pack when the device has enough memory; keep it out of the default download.

release_gates: run the local UI smoke test
verify each model artifact loads in its declared runtime
record model revision, tokenizer, prompt template, quantization, and metrics
review model card and license for every artifact
generate checksums and sign the release manifest
publish only after explicit owner approval
